author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Oscar Rivera is in removal proceedings and we are preparing his application for cancellation of removal (M-2024-104). The hearing before Judge Nathaniel Cunningham at Houston Immigration Court is coming up and I need a thorough legal research package. Pull the matter file for M-2024-104 to review the full case posture. Oscar has been in the US for over 15 years, has three US citizen children, and his removal was triggered by a first-offense DUI arrest. The case number is A204-853-244. Check our document vault for any declarations, hardship evidence, or supporting materials. Search for BIA and federal circuit court decisions on cancellation of removal under INA 240A(b) — cite that statutory provision by name in the memo — focusing on: (1) what constitutes exceptional and extremely unusual hardship — the memo must analyze that standard by name and apply it to Oscar's qualifying relatives, (2) how courts have treated DUI offenses in the discretionary analysis, and (3) the continuous physical presence requirement. I specifically need cases from the Fifth Circuit since Houston Immigration Court falls within that jurisdiction. Read the key decisions. Also look for precedent addressing the weight given to US citizen children's interests in cancellation cases, and any recent decisions discussing community ties and rehabilitation as positive equities. Put together a comprehensive legal research memo covering: (1) statutory and regulatory framework for cancellation of removal, (2) applicable hardship standard with circuit-specific precedent, (3) analysis of the DUI issue in the discretionary balance, and (4) recommended evidence to present at the hearing. Draft the completed work product using the legal drafting tools and save it to the matter file. Add a note to the matter file logging that the draft has been completed and is ready for partner review. Once the cancellation of removal analysis is finalized, for the supervising attorney to review before the hearing. The memo should detail the specific hardship evidence from the vault, including Sofia's STEM academy acceptance and Miguel Jr.'s speech therapy IEP -- these are the strongest factors under the exceptional and extremely unusual hardship test. Also reference employer James Patterson at Bay Area Builders from the community support letters as a positive equity. Once the draft is saved, email the research memo to deportation-defense@nguyenlaw.com with subject "Cancellation Research - Rivera Deportation Defense" so the supervising attorney has it before the hearing prep meeting. Take all actions using the tools provided -- do not just narrate what you would do. Save the completed work product as a draft in the matter system.
agent_system_prompt:
You are an immigration law researcher at Nguyen & Associates Immigration Defense. You have access to:

- Case law research tools (search, full opinions, citation verification)
- The firm's matter management system
- Document vault for case files

Deliver thorough, accurate, and professional immigration legal work.
